# Lenovo Legion Pro 7 16IAX10H Q7CN78WW firmware state

Primary source: https://support.lenovo.com/cw/en/downloads/ds574156

Lenovo lists Q7CN78WW, dated 12 June 2026, as the recommended BIOS for the exact 16IAX10H platform. Its official changelog fixes a black screen after S3 resume with Legion Optimization enabled and changes CPU-overclocking, thermal and power tables. Multiple recent owner reports separately associate Q7CN78WW with NVMe disappearance/`UNEXPECTED_STORE_EXCEPTION`, audio trouble and constrained rollback. Owner reports alone do not prove universal failure, but their recency, shared exact platform/BIOS and the buyer's no-debugging rule are sufficient to block a recommendation until Lenovo publishes a superseding fix or exact professional evidence clears shipping units.
